## Purpose
Describe the business or technical problem this change solves.

## Scope
- What changed?
- What did not change?
- Are business rules or data structures affected?

## Verification
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Type check passes
- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] Tenant isolation and role permissions reviewed
- [ ] Migration and rollback plan included, if applicable

## Security and data
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or production records committed
- [ ] No client-side state treated as authorization
- [ ] No cross-tenant access introduced
- [ ] Production database changes are separately authorized

## Evidence
Add logs, screenshots, test output, or explain what could not be verified.
